description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration granted approval to zanidatamab-hrii, a bispecific human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-directed antibody, in combination with fluoropyrimidine- and platinum-containing chemotherapy, for the first-line treatment of adult patients with HER2-positive (immunohistochemistry [IHC] 3+) unresectable locally advanced or metastatic gastric, gastroesophageal junction, or esophageal adenocarcinoma, as detected by an FDA-authorized test. In HERIZON-GEA-01 (NCT05152147), a randomized, 3-arm, open-label, active-comparator trial, the chemotherapy regimens were capecitabine and oxaliplatin (CAPOX) or cisplatin and fluorouracil (FP).

contributions.description: Initial curation of FDA's approval of Ziihera (zanidatamab-hrii) for HER2+ (IHC 3+) GEA, first-line, with chemotherapy.
